title: A Wardrobe for the Undertow
author: F. M. Okafor
blurb: Felix Underhill, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
